products.name: Live
products.description: The long-running Significant Hobbies experience for recording, exploring, and acting on a life lived beyond passive consumption.

purposeContract.outcome: Build a personal catalogue of things worth doing and keep moving from possibility toward lived experience.

products.name: Local AI Video Studio
products.description: A local-first Mac studio for comparing reproducible video-effect variants before export.

purposeContract.purpose: Local AI Video Studio helps a creator compare reproducible local video effects before choosing and exporting a result.
purposeContract.audience: A Mac-based creator who wants deterministic editing options before paying for generative video.
purposeContract.outcome: Translate an editing intention into visible effect variants and choose a result that can be reproduced.
purposeContract.mechanism: A native Mac studio uses AVFoundation, Core Image, and hardware video tools to render comparable local variants from one source.
purposeContract.proof: The bounded local experiment works, but owner interest faded before a recurring creator workflow was established.
purposeContract.nextAction: Treat it as a held local experiment; reopen only around a real creator job where deterministic effects clearly help.

products.name: Look Sideways
products.description: Explore 3,578 documented early-breakthrough paths without pretending success follows a formula.

purposeContract.purpose: Look Sideways shows why visible success cannot be reduced to a simple formula or a fair comparison with your own path.
purposeContract.audience: Readers who turn another person’s visible outcome into a judgment about their own pace, ability, or worth.
purposeContract.outcome: Replace flattened comparison with a more humane, evidence-bounded understanding of conditions, sequence, perseverance, and luck.
purposeContract.mechanism: A guided research exhibit connects source-linked life events and early-breakthrough paths through what people brought, were handed, and were surrounded by.
purposeContract.proof: The publication contains thousands of documented early-breakthrough paths, visible methodology, and ongoing source-linked profile coverage.
purposeContract.nextAction: Complete the guided comparison-futility journey, then inspect the underlying profiles, sources, and coverage.

products.name: LoopTV
products.description: A lean-back, TV-style random video player for curated channels.

purposeContract.purpose: LoopTV turns curated YouTube channels into a calmer, lean-back television experience.
purposeContract.audience: Viewers who want intentional channel selection without YouTube’s endless recommendation feed.
purposeContract.outcome: Start watching something suitable quickly while retaining control over the available catalogue.
purposeContract.mechanism: A TV-like random player uses curated channels, focused search, and resilient handling of unavailable videos.
purposeContract.proof: The maintained product is complete for its intended viewing loop and already handles common catalogue failures.
purposeContract.nextAction: Open a curated channel and watch; future changes are limited to catalogue health or a proven viewing need.

products.name: Memory Map
products.description: Turn a ChatGPT export into a private, browser-computed map of recurring themes, facts, and conversations.

purposeContract.purpose: Memory Map turns an exported AI conversation history into a private map of recurring themes, facts, emotions, and change.
purposeContract.audience: People curious about patterns across their own ChatGPT history who do not want to upload the archive to a service.
purposeContract.outcome: Recognize recurring concerns and how interests, language, and personal themes changed over time.
purposeContract.mechanism: The browser computes structured conversation analysis locally from an imported export and presents linked historical views.
purposeContract.proof: A useful browser-local dashboard exists today; deeper shift analysis and additional export sources remain active work.
purposeContract.nextAction: Import a ChatGPT export locally and explore the resulting private map; the source archive stays in the browser.

products.name: Motion
products.description: Use your body as the controller for an iPhone-hosted game that can mirror to a larger screen.

purposeContract.purpose: Motion turns body movement seen by an iPhone into the controls for playful games on a larger screen.
purposeContract.audience: People who want active, social play without buying a dedicated motion-console system.
purposeContract.outcome: Move, play, and exercise through a game that responds directly to the body.
purposeContract.mechanism: The iPhone performs body tracking and hosts the game while mirroring the experience to a television or larger display.
purposeContract.proof: A promising native prototype exists, but physical control feel, fun, and distribution remain unproven on real devices.
purposeContract.nextAction: Treat it as a held prototype; reopen around physical-device testing of one genuinely fun control loop.

products.name: Office OS
products.description: A local-first Mac workplace where named AI employees have bounded responsibilities and their work stays inspectable.

purposeContract.audience: An owner who wants useful non-technical AI employees without managing prompts, workflows, or agent infrastructure directly.
purposeContract.outcome: Delegate bounded responsibilities, see progress and blockers, review artifacts, intervene safely, and resume work across days.
purposeContract.mechanism: Named employees have durable roles, memory, workspaces, skills, scoped authority, and inspectable outcome loops inside a local organization folder.
purposeContract.proof: A credible local proof of concept can run a bounded writer-manager workday, but differentiation and recurring owner use remain unproven.
purposeContract.nextAction: Review the local proof; reopen product investment only after comparing strong alternatives and proving one recurring workflow.

products.name: PSI Swarm
products.description: Repeated Lighthouse distributions for honest website performance tracking.

purposeContract.purpose: PSI Swarm measures website performance as repeated distributions instead of a single flattering Lighthouse run.
purposeContract.audience: The Fleet operator and developers who need trustworthy performance evidence across public products.
purposeContract.outcome: See typical performance, variability, and regressions under repeated real measurement conditions.
purposeContract.mechanism: An operational CLI runs and aggregates multiple PageSpeed and Lighthouse observations for Site Health.
purposeContract.proof: The completed measurement tool already feeds repeated performance evidence into the portfolio dashboard.
purposeContract.nextAction: Run it for a concrete performance investigation or consume its evidence in Site Health; keep the tool operationally narrow.

products.name: Reader
products.description: Capture, annotate, revisit, and discuss saved reading.

purposeContract.purpose: Reader turns a saved article or PDF into a focused place to read, annotate, revisit, and discuss it.
purposeContract.audience: People who save serious reading but lose it among browser tabs and undifferentiated bookmarks.
purposeContract.outcome: Move from capture to attentive reading and retain useful notes and questions around the source.
purposeContract.mechanism: A dedicated reading surface combines capture, document parsing, annotation, retrieval, and source-grounded discussion.
purposeContract.proof: The product is mature, but current owner usage is too low to justify speculative expansion.
purposeContract.nextAction: Use Reader for a real article or PDF; resume improvements only where the capture-to-reading loop actually breaks.

products.name: Research Papers
products.description: Academic paper discovery and a structured research data asset.

purposeContract.audience: The Fleet owner investigating a concrete product, technical, or market question.
purposeContract.outcome: Find relevant papers and retrieve grounded context from a large retained corpus.
purposeContract.mechanism: A curated research dataset is indexed for search and retrieval-assisted analysis with source structure intact.
purposeContract.proof: The corpus and discovery system are essentially complete and available when a real research question appears.

products.name: RolePatch

purposeContract.audience: A job seeker preparing a serious application for a particular role.
purposeContract.outcome: Present relevant experience more clearly and prepare for the role without inventing qualifications.
purposeContract.mechanism: The product joins job-description analysis, resume tailoring, role research, proof review, and interview preparation in one workflow.
purposeContract.proof: A strong working product exists, including the evidence ideas retained from TrueHire, but owner job-search intent is currently absent.
purposeContract.nextAction: Use it against a real application when job hunting resumes; until then, treat the product as held rather than actively marketed.

purposeContract.outcome: Build causal understanding that survives recall and can be demonstrated through code, diagrams, explanations, or projects.
